facts.note: Transcript states the kitchen clock is a quarter of an hour fast and that it is kept so on purpose so nothing is late.
Transcript states Lina came down to the kitchen at thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stayed with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
Transcript states the piano began at two minutes to eleven and stopped at eleven minutes past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
Transcript states the hall clock struck eleven when the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven.
